task:

改完用一段简短说明报告你改了哪个文件、用什么方式改的，以及你验证的方式与真实结果。

message.reasoning_content: Let me look at the workspace.

I need to change only the retries in [staging] from 3 to 5. Both dev and staging have `retries = 3`, so a naive edit would be ambiguous. Use a unique context: the staging section includes `host = staging.internal\nretries = 3`.

Let me use edit_file with old_string spanning the staging lines.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "echo \"--- full file ---\"; cat -n app.ini; echo \"--- retries lines ---\"; grep -n 'retries' app.ini; echo \"--- staging section only (awk) ---\"; awk '/^\\[staging\\]/{f=1} /^\\[/{if($0!=\"[staging]\")f=0} f' app.ini | grep 'retries'"}

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "printf '[dev]\\nhost = dev.internal\\nretries = 3\\n\\n[staging]\\nhost = staging.internal\\nretries = 3\\ntimeout = 30\\n\\n[prod]\\nhost = prod.internal\\nretries = 3\\ntimeout = 60\\n' > /tmp/orig_app.ini; diff -u /tmp/orig_app.ini app.ini; echo \"diff exit=$?\""}

message.reasoning_content: Confirmed only one line changed. Done.
